zh.whoYouAre: 你是一块淬炼过的铁——外表冷静，内里却燃着火。那种不动声色的坚定，是不需要向任何人证明的。
zh.howYouLove: 你爱得像一座山。不张扬，但一直都在。你需要的是一个能看懂你沉默的人，而不是需要你解释的人。
zh.whereYouThrive: 你的天赋不在于执行别人的计划，而在于看到别人看不到的可能性。你最适合的角色是开创者。
zh.yourShadows: 你有一个温柔的陷阱——太想扛住一切，忘了自己也需要被照顾。学会示弱，是你今年最好的礼物。
zh.yourSeason: 你现在正处在转变的边缘。表面一切如常，但内心深处已经知道有些东西该放下了。不是冲刺的时候，是整理的时候。
zh.theFullPicture: 你是寒铁中的火种——表面冷静理性，内里热烈坚定。世界需要你的沉默力量，也需要你偶尔的失控。

en.whoYouAre: You're forged like steel that keeps its warmth — calm on the surface, fire underneath. The quiet force that doesn't need to announce itself.
en.howYouLove: You love like a mountain. Steady, present, not loud. What you need isn't someone who asks questions — it's someone who reads the silence.
en.whereYouThrive: Your gift lies not in executing someone else's plan, but in seeing what others miss. You're built to pioneer.
en.yourShadows: You carry a gentle trap — wanting to hold everything together so much that you forget to rest. Learning to say 'I need help' is your gift this season.
en.yourSeason: You're standing at the edge of a quiet shift. Everything looks the same on the surface, but you already know something is ready to change. This is for gathering, not pushing.
en.theFullPicture: A quiet fire wrapped in steel — that's who you are. Steady on the outside, fiercely alive within. The world needs your grounded presence... and your wild heart.

zh.whoYouAre: 你像一阵风——轻盈、自由、让人捉摸不定。但风的下面，是深不见底的海洋。你的表面是笑，内里是故事。
zh.howYouLove: 你爱得热烈又善变。不是不专一，而是你在每段关系里都投入了不同的自己。你需要的是一个能接住你所有版本的人。
zh.whereYouThrive: 你的天赋是连接——连接人、连接想法、连接看似不相关的事物。你是天生的桥梁建造者。
zh.yourShadows: 你有一个习惯——用忙碌逃避安静。停下来的时候，那些被你忽略的感受会一起涌上来。学会独处，是你最被低估的力量。
zh.yourSeason: 你正处于一个播种期。很多想法在发芽，但还没到收获的时候。耐心一点，让种子自己长出来。
zh.theFullPicture: 你是风中的水——柔软却有穿透力。表面轻盈，内里深沉。世界需要你的灵动，也需要你偶尔的安静。

en.whoYouAre: You're like the wind — light, free, impossible to pin down. But underneath the breeze is an ocean. Your surface is laughter; your depth is story.
en.howYouLove: You love fiercely and restlessly. Not because you're fickle, but because you show up as a different version of yourself in every connection. You need someone who catches all of them.
en.whereYouThrive: Your gift is connection — linking people, ideas, things that seem unrelated. You're a natural bridge-builder.
en.yourShadows: You have a habit of outrunning stillness. When you stop, the feelings you've been avoiding surface all at once. Solitude is your most underrated strength.
en.yourSeason: You're in a planting season. Many ideas are sprouting, but harvest isn't here yet. Be patient — let the seeds grow on their own.
en.theFullPicture: Water in the wind — soft yet penetrating. Light on the surface, deep within. The world needs your sparkle... and your occasional silence.

zh.whoYouAre: 你是一棵老橡树——根扎得深，枝叶不一定张扬，但暴风雨来的时候，所有人都会躲到你下面。
zh.howYouLove: 你爱得实在。不说情话，但会记住她喜欢的咖啡温度。你的浪漫藏在细节里，需要有心人才能发现。
zh.whereYouThrive: 你的天赋是把混乱变成秩序。在别人看到烂摊子的地方，你看到了系统。你适合做架构师——不管是建筑、代码还是人生。
zh.yourShadows: 你太相信'坚持就是胜利'，有时候忘了方向比努力更重要。学会放弃，不是认输，是智慧。
zh.yourSeason: 你正在收获前几年种下的东西。有些果实比预期甜，有些不如意。接受不完美，继续往前走。
zh.theFullPicture: 大地之木——根基深厚，生长缓慢但从未停止。你的力量不在速度，在持久。世界需要你的稳定，那是最稀缺的品质。

en.whoYouAre: You're an old oak — roots deep, branches not always showy, but when the storm hits, everyone shelters under you.
en.howYouLove: You love with substance. No poetry, but you remember her coffee order. Your romance lives in details — only the attentive will find it.
en.whereYouThrive: Your gift is turning chaos into order. Where others see a mess, you see a system. You're built to be an architect — of buildings, code, or life.
en.yourShadows: You believe too hard that persistence wins everything. Sometimes direction matters more than effort. Learning to quit isn't surrender — it's wisdom.
en.yourSeason: You're harvesting what you planted years ago. Some fruit is sweeter than expected, some isn't. Accept the imperfection and keep walking.
en.theFullPicture: Earth-wood — deep-rooted, slow-growing, never stopping. Your strength isn't speed, it's endurance. The world needs your steadiness — the rarest quality of all.

zh.whoYouAre: 你是月光下的火焰——温柔却有温度，安静却能照亮一整间屋子。你的力量不在于大声说话，在于让人安心。
zh.howYouLove: 你爱得像潮汐——有进有退，但永远不会真正离开。你需要安全感，但更重要的是，你需要一个值得你付出安全感的人。
zh.whereYouThrive: 你的天赋是治愈。不是那种刻意的，而是你走进一个房间，空气就变了。你适合做任何需要同理心的工作。
zh.yourShadows: 你太容易吸收别人的情绪，最后分不清哪些是自己的，哪些是别人的。情绪边界是你最需要学习的功课。
zh.yourSeason: 你正在经历一次内在的蜕变。有些旧伤正在愈合，有些新的力量正在生长。不要急，这是你的疗愈季。
zh.theFullPicture: 月火相映——表面柔情似水，内里烈焰如歌。你的敏感不是弱点，是超能力。世界需要你的温柔力量。

en.whoYouAre: You're moonfire — gentle yet warm, quiet yet enough to light a whole room. Your power isn't in loudness; it's in making people feel safe.
en.howYouLove: You love like the tide — ebbing and flowing, but never truly leaving. You need security, but more than that, you need someone worth being secure for.
en.whereYouThrive: Your gift is healing. Not the intentional kind — the kind where you walk into a room and the air changes. You're built for any work that needs empathy.
en.yourShadows: You absorb other people's emotions so easily that you lose track of which feelings are yours. Emotional boundaries are your most important lesson.
en.yourSeason: You're going through an inner metamorphosis. Old wounds are healing, new strength is growing. Don't rush — this is your healing season.
en.theFullPicture: Moon and fire intertwined — tender on the surface, blazing within. Your sensitivity isn't weakness; it's a superpower. The world needs your gentle fire.

en.whoYouAre: You're a dormant volcano — quiet as a mountain most days, but you know you could erupt at any moment. Choosing not to — that's real power.

en.whereYouThrive: Your gift is seeing through surfaces. While others are fooled by appearances, you've already found the underlying logic. Built for strategy, analysis, or any role that needs deep insight.

en.yourSeason: You're in a quiet revolution. The old you is dying; the new you is being born. The process is uncomfortable, but the result is worth it.
en.theFullPicture: Deep earth, sharp within — silent on the surface, cutting underneath. Your insight is a double-edged sword: wielded well it's wisdom, overused it's loneliness. The world needs your depth.

zh.theFullPicture: 你是暗夜中的火炬——不需要理由，存在本身就是照亮。你的热情，是给世界的礼物。

zh.yourSeason: 你正站在一个十字路口——旧的路走到了尽头，新的路还没完全显现。这是转型期。

en.whoYouAre: You're a mountain — silent, but everyone knows you're there.

en.yourShadows: You're too stubborn — once you've decided, you don't look back. But sometimes stepping back isn't surrender. It's wisdom.
en.yourSeason: You're at a crossroads — the old road has ended, the new one hasn't fully appeared. This is transformation.
en.theFullPicture: The earth's anchor — while everyone drifts, you're the one who steadies everything.

en.whoYouAre: You're all-or-nothing. Either you don't start, or you burn all the way through.
en.howYouLove: You love with substance. No poetry, but you remember her coffee order three months later.
en.whereYouThrive: Your gift is nurturing. You're built for education, healthcare, or any role that needs warmth and attention.
en.yourShadows: You burn too fast — passion arrives quickly and leaves just as quickly. Learn to slow down. Turn wildfire into hearthfire.
en.yourSeason: You're in exploration mode — everything is new, everything is exciting. Don't rush to decide. See the world first.
en.theFullPicture: A torch in the dark — no reason needed, your existence is the light. Your fire is a gift to the world.

zh.whoYouAre: 你的智慧像水一样——无形，却能适应任何容器。

zh.whereYouThrive: 你的天赋是拆解复杂问题。你适合做研究者——在别人觉得无聊的地方，你发现了乐趣。

zh.yourSeason: 你正在从"什么都想要"变成"知道自己要什么"。这个转变不舒服，但很必要。
zh.theFullPicture: 你是深海中的光——表面平静，内里波澜壮阔。你的深度，是这个世界最稀缺的品质。

en.whoYouAre: You're like the deep ocean — calm on the surface, holding the world's secrets underneath.
en.howYouLove: You're the giver in relationships — always giving more, sometimes forgetting you need love too.

en.yourSeason: You're shifting from 'wanting everything' to 'knowing what you want.' The transition is uncomfortable but necessary.

en.whoYouAre: Your resilience is your superpower. Setbacks don't break you; they feed you.

en.yourShadows: You believe too hard that effort equals success. Sometimes direction matters more than speed. Stop and think — it's not weakness.
en.yourSeason: Your life is just beginning. All the confusion is normal. All the trial and error has value.
en.theFullPicture: A sprout on solid ground — fragile-looking, but with the power to split rock. Your growth is unstoppable.

en.theFullPicture: A sprout on solid ground — fragile-looking, but with the power to split rock. Your growth is unstoppable.

en.whoYouAre: You're a tree still growing — roots deeper, branches wider, reaching for something most people can't see.
en.howYouLove: What you value most in a relationship is mental connection — someone you can talk to until 3am beats a pretty face every time.

en.yourShadows: You believe too hard that effort equals success. Sometimes direction matters more than speed. Stop and think — it's not weakness.
en.yourSeason: You're shifting from 'wanting everything' to 'knowing what you want.' The transition is uncomfortable but necessary.
en.theFullPicture: A sprout on solid ground — fragile-looking, but with the power to split rock. Your growth is unstoppable.

en.whoYouAre: You're the summer sun — warm, direct, impossible to ignore.
en.howYouLove: You're the one who makes the first move — unafraid of giving, unafraid of getting hurt.

en.yourShadows: You burn too fast — passion arrives quickly and leaves just as quickly. Learn to slow down. Turn wildfire into hearthfire.
en.yourSeason: You're harvesting what you planted years ago. Some fruit is sweet, some isn't. Accept the imperfection and keep walking.
en.theFullPicture: A torch in the dark — no reason needed, your existence is the light. Your fire is a gift to the world.
